name: @vietthai/figma-remote-mcp-go

tools.name: add_component_property
tools.description: Add a component property to a COMPONENT_SET or a COMPONENT outside a set (for a variant, pass its set), optionally binding layers right away: BOOLEAN shows/hides the layers (visible), TEXT sets their text (TEXT layers), INSTANCE_SWAP swaps their component (INSTANCE layers). VARIANT (sets only) adds a variant property to every variant with defaultValue. Everything is checked first: a bad layer or default adds nothing. TEXT: every bound layer shows the default, so layers with different texts are rejected unless defaultValue is given (the result then lists the replaced texts in overwritten [{id, name, from}]). Instances then take the property in create_instance / set_instance_properties. On a set, the set is then fitted to its variants again (a default can resize them). Returns {nodeId, property, key, type, default, boundLayers}.

defaultValue.description: BOOLEAN: true or false (default true). TEXT: text (default: the bound layers' text, which must then be the same in all). INSTANCE_SWAP: a COMPONENT node ID (default: the first bound instance's component). VARIANT: the value every variant gets (required)

layers.description: Layer IDs inside the component (inside a variant for a set, not inside a nested instance) to bind to the property

nodeId.description: COMPONENT_SET, or COMPONENT not in a set, in colon format

preferredValues.description: INSTANCE_SWAP only: COMPONENT or COMPONENT_SET IDs offered as swap choices in Figma's UI

tools.name: add_page
tools.description: Add a new page to the Figma document.

index.description: Position index to insert the page (0 = first). Defaults to last position.

tools.name: add_variable_mode
tools.description: Add a new mode to an existing variable collection (e.g. Light/Dark, Desktop/Mobile). IMPORTANT — Figma free plan only allows 1 mode per collection; calling this tool on a free-plan account will return the error 'Limited to 1 modes only'. If that error occurs, stop retrying and switch to the name-prefix workaround: keep the single default mode and create variables prefixed by mode, e.g. 'light/color-bg' and 'dark/color-bg' in the same collection. Tell the user that native multi-mode variables require a paid Figma plan (Professional or above).

tools.name: apply_style_to_node
tools.description: Apply an existing style (paint, text, effect, or grid) to a node, linking the node to that style: a local style, or a library style already used in the file (get_styles includeUsed).

nodeId.description: Target node ID in colon format e.g. 4029:12345

styleId.description: Style ID to apply (from get_styles, or its 'used' list for library styles)

target.description: For paint styles only — apply to 'fill' (default) or 'stroke'

tools.name: batch_rename_nodes
tools.description: Rename multiple nodes using find/replace, regex substitution, or prefix/suffix addition.

find.description: String (or regex pattern when useRegex=true) to search for in the node name

nodeIds.description: Node IDs in colon format e.g. ['4029:12345']

prefix.description: String to prepend to the node name

regexFlags.description: Regex flags e.g. 'gi' (default 'g'). Only used when useRegex=true.

replace.description: Replacement string. Required when find is provided.

suffix.description: String to append to the node name

useRegex.description: Treat find as a regular expression (default false)

tools.name: batch_write
tools.description: Run many write operations in one call, in order: build a whole card or screen at once instead of one tool call per node. Each operation is {op, params, ref?}: op is a write tool name and params are that tool's own arguments. Give an operation a ref (e.g. "card") and later operations can use "$card" in any node ID param (parentId, nodeId, nodeIds…) for the node it created. Everything is validated before anything runs. Stops at the first failing operation and returns the results so far with the error; rollback: true then deletes the nodes this batch created (other changes stay). An operation that takes over 60 s (a hang) fails the batch the same way, and a batch the server stops waiting for stops before its next operation, so a failed batch never keeps running behind your back. In Figma the whole batch is one undo step: one Ctrl+Z reverts all of it. Returns {results: [{op, ref?, …tool result}], completed, total}.

op.description: Write tool name e.g. create_frame, set_fills

ref.description: Name for the node this operation creates; later operations use "$name"

rollback.description: On failure, delete the nodes created by earlier operations of this batch (default false: keep them)

tools.name: bind_variable_to_node
tools.description: Bind a local variable to a node property so the property is driven by the variable's value. COLOR variables: use fillColor or strokeColor. BOOLEAN variables: use visible. FLOAT variables: use opacity (a percent variable, 0–100, e.g. 40 = 40%, as in Figma's UI; a value in 0–1 returns a warning), rotation, width, height, cornerRadius, topLeftRadius, topRightRadius, bottomLeftRadius, bottomRightRadius, strokeWeight, itemSpacing, paddingTop, paddingRight, paddingBottom, paddingLeft.

field.description: Property to bind: fillColor | strokeColor | visible | opacity | rotation | width | height | cornerRadius | topLeftRadius | topRightRadius | bottomLeftRadius | bottomRightRadius | strokeWeight | itemSpacing | paddingTop | paddingRight | paddingBottom | paddingLeft

nodeId.description: Target node ID in colon format e.g. 4029:12345

tools.name: clone_node
tools.description: Clone an existing node, optionally repositioning it or placing it in a new parent. Without parentId the clone goes right above the source in the same parent, at the same position. Cloning a COMPONENT makes another component, not an instance (use create_instance for that). Returns the clone's id, parentId and bounds.

nodeId.description: Source node ID in colon format e.g. '4029:12345'

parentId.description: Parent node ID for the clone (appended as the last child). Defaults to the source's parent.

x.description: X position of the clone, relative to its parent (ignored inside auto-layout)

y.description: Y position of the clone, relative to its parent (ignored inside auto-layout)

tools.name: combine_as_variants
tools.description: Combine COMPONENT nodes into a COMPONENT_SET (Figma's Combine as variants). Variant property values come from each component's name "Prop=Value, Prop2=Value2" (a shared path such as "Chip/State=Default" becomes the set name, leaving "State=Default"); pass variants to set them here instead of renaming first. Two variants with the same values are rejected. The variants are laid out (layout GRID by default: one row per value of the first property, one column per combination of the others; a single property makes one row) and the set is sized to them with 20 px padding; it takes the first component's place. Figma's UI also draws a dashed purple border on new sets; this tool does not (add it with set_strokes if wanted). Component IDs stay the same. Each property lists its values in componentIds order (Figma fixes that order when combining), and the variant layers follow the layout. Pass one COMPONENT_SET ID alone to lay its variants out again after their sizes changed, in the order of the set's values (layout/gap/name/x/y apply; KEEP only fits the set to them). Returns {id, name, type, properties, variantIds, bounds}; add BOOLEAN/TEXT/INSTANCE_SWAP properties with add_component_property.

componentIds.description: COMPONENT node IDs (not in a set yet, all on one page) in colon format; or one COMPONENT_SET ID to re-arrange its variants

layout.description: How to arrange the variants in the set: GRID (default), ROW (one row, in componentIds order) or KEEP (leave them where they are on the canvas)

name.description: Component set name (default: the "/" path the component names share, e.g. "Button" for Button/Small and Button/Large)

parentId.description: Parent for the set in colon format (default: the first component's parent)

variants.description: Optional variant values per component, e.g. [{"componentId": "1:2", "properties": {"Size": "Small", "State": "Hover"}}]: the component is renamed "Size=Small, State=Hover". Components not listed keep their names

x.description: X of the set in its parent (default: where the first component was)

y.description: Y of the set in its parent (default: where the first component was)

tools.name: create_component
tools.description: Convert an existing node (usually a FRAME; also GROUP, RECTANGLE, TEXT…) into a reusable COMPONENT, like Figma's Create component. Everything is kept: children, fills/effects and their styles, clip, auto-layout and sizing, bound variables, constraints, prototype reactions and the place in the parent. The component replaces the node and has a new id (sourceId in the result is the old one). Not for instances, components, or nodes inside a component or instance. Components nested in the node are moved out to the page by Figma and replaced by instances (listed in movedComponents).

name.description: Optional name for the component. Defaults to the node's current name.

nodeId.description: Node ID to convert, in colon format e.g. '4029:12345'

tools.name: create_effect_style
tools.description: Create a new local effect style (drop shadow, inner shadow, or blur). If a local style with this name exists, it is returned unchanged (existing: true).

color.description: Shadow color as hex e.g. #000000 (default #000000, shadows only)

offsetX.description: Shadow X offset in pixels (default 0, shadows only)

offsetY.description: Shadow Y offset in pixels (default 4, shadows only)

radius.description: Blur radius in pixels (default 8 for shadows, 4 for blurs)

spread.description: Shadow spread in pixels (default 0, shadows only)

type.description: Effect type: DROP_SHADOW (default), INNER_SHADOW, LAYER_BLUR, or BACKGROUND_BLUR

tools.name: create_ellipse
tools.description: Create a new ellipse (circle/oval) on the current page or inside a parent node.

layoutPositioning.description: AUTO (follow the parent's auto-layout flow) or ABSOLUTE (keep x/y and ignore the flow, e.g. a badge on a card)

layoutSizingHorizontal.description: Width sizing in an auto-layout parent: FIXED (keep the size), HUG (fit the content; auto-layout frames and text only) or FILL (stretch to fill the auto-layout parent)

layoutSizingVertical.description: Height sizing in an auto-layout parent: FIXED (keep the size), HUG (fit the content; auto-layout frames and text only) or FILL (stretch to fill the auto-layout parent)

parentId.description: Parent node ID in colon format. Defaults to current page.

tools.name: create_frame
tools.description: Create a new frame on the current page or inside a parent node, optionally with auto-layout, fill, stroke, corner radius, and FILL/HUG sizing in an auto-layout parent.

clipsContent.description: Clip children to the frame bounds (default true); false lets them overflow

counterAxisAlignItems.description: Cross-axis alignment: MIN, CENTER, MAX, or BASELINE

counterAxisSizingMode.description: Cross-axis sizing: FIXED or AUTO (hug). Default: FIXED when the size on that axis is given, else AUTO

counterAxisSpacing.description: Gap between wrapped rows/columns (only when layoutWrap is WRAP)

fillColor.description: Fill color as hex e.g. #FFFFFF (default white), or 'none' for a transparent frame (e.g. a layout-only wrapper)

height.description: Height in pixels (default 100). With auto-layout, a given height stays fixed (sizing FIXED) unless the axis sizing mode says AUTO; without a height the frame hugs its content vertically (Figma's Add auto layout); an empty frame keeps the default 100 until it has children

layoutMode.description: Auto-layout direction: HORIZONTAL, VERTICAL, or NONE

layoutPositioning.description: AUTO (follow the parent's auto-layout flow) or ABSOLUTE (keep x/y and ignore the flow, e.g. a badge on a card)

layoutSizingHorizontal.description: Width sizing in an auto-layout parent: FIXED (keep the size), HUG (fit the content; auto-layout frames and text only) or FILL (stretch to fill the auto-layout parent)

layoutSizingVertical.description: Height sizing in an auto-layout parent: FIXED (keep the size), HUG (fit the content; auto-layout frames and text only) or FILL (stretch to fill the auto-layout parent)

parentId.description: Parent node ID in colon format. Defaults to current page.

primaryAxisAlignItems.description: Main-axis alignment: MIN, CENTER, MAX, or SPACE_BETWEEN

primaryAxisSizingMode.description: Main-axis sizing: FIXED or AUTO (hug). Default: FIXED when the size on that axis is given, else AUTO

strokeColor.description: Stroke (border) color as hex e.g. #E2E8F0, drawn inside

strokeWeight.description: Stroke weight in pixels (default 1 when strokeColor is given)

strokesIncludedInLayout.description: Auto-layout only: true counts the stroke in the frame's size and padding. Default false, as in Figma's UI (a bordered frame is as big as one without)

width.description: Width in pixels (default 100). With auto-layout, a given width stays fixed (sizing FIXED) unless the axis sizing mode says AUTO; without a width the frame hugs its content horizontally (Figma's Add auto layout); an empty frame keeps the default 100 until it has children

tools.name: create_grid_style
tools.description: Create a new local layout grid style. If a local style with this name exists, it is returned unchanged (existing: true).

alignment.description: Alignment: STRETCH (default: columns/rows stretch to fill), CENTER, MIN, or MAX (fixed-size columns/rows placed in the middle, at the start or at the end; these need sectionSize). COLUMNS/ROWS only

color.description: Grid line color as hex e.g. #FF0000 (GRID only, default #FF0000)

count.description: Number of columns or rows (COLUMNS/ROWS only, default 12)

gutterSize.description: Gutter size in pixels (COLUMNS/ROWS only, default 16)

offset.description: Margin/offset in pixels (COLUMNS/ROWS only, default 0; not for CENTER alignment)

pattern.description: Grid pattern: GRID (default), COLUMNS, or ROWS

sectionSize.description: GRID: cell size in pixels (default 8). COLUMNS/ROWS: width of each column / height of each row, required when alignment is MIN, MAX or CENTER (STRETCH sizes them to fill)

tools.name: create_instance
tools.description: Create an INSTANCE of a local component (to copy an existing instance, use clone_node). componentId may be a COMPONENT, or a COMPONENT_SET whose default variant is used; pick another variant with properties e.g. {"Size": "Large"}. Property names are as get_local_components lists them (add BOOLEAN/TEXT/INSTANCE_SWAP properties to a component with add_component_property). Returns the instance id, mainComponentId, componentProperties and bounds.

componentId.description: COMPONENT or COMPONENT_SET node ID in colon format (from get_local_components)

layoutPositioning.description: AUTO (follow the parent's auto-layout flow) or ABSOLUTE (keep x/y and ignore the flow, e.g. a badge on a card)

layoutSizingHorizontal.description: Width sizing in an auto-layout parent: FIXED (keep the size), HUG (fit the content; auto-layout frames and text only) or FILL (stretch to fill the auto-layout parent)

layoutSizingVertical.description: Height sizing in an auto-layout parent: FIXED (keep the size), HUG (fit the content; auto-layout frames and text only) or FILL (stretch to fill the auto-layout parent)

parentId.description: Parent node ID in colon format. Defaults to current page.

properties.description: Component property values by name, e.g. {"Size": "Large", "Label": "Pay now", "Show icon": false}. Names are as get_local_components lists them (the '#…' suffix is optional); VARIANT takes one of its options, BOOLEAN true/false, TEXT a string, INSTANCE_SWAP a COMPONENT node ID

x.description: X position, relative to the parent (default 0; ignored inside auto-layout)

y.description: Y position, relative to the parent (default 0; ignored inside auto-layout)

tools.name: create_line
tools.description: Create a straight line from (x1, y1) to (x2, y2), in pixels relative to the parent (dividers, connectors, arrows via strokeCap, which Figma applies to both ends). Returns the line's id, bounds, length and rotation. Restyle it later with set_strokes.

dashPattern.description: Dash and gap lengths e.g. [4, 4]; [] for solid

layoutPositioning.description: AUTO (follow the parent's auto-layout flow) or ABSOLUTE (keep x/y and ignore the flow, e.g. a badge on a card)

layoutSizingHorizontal.description: Width sizing in an auto-layout parent: FIXED (keep the size), HUG (fit the content; auto-layout frames and text only) or FILL (stretch to fill the auto-layout parent)

layoutSizingVertical.description: Height sizing in an auto-layout parent: FIXED (keep the size), HUG (fit the content; auto-layout frames and text only) or FILL (stretch to fill the auto-layout parent)

parentId.description: Parent node ID in colon format. Defaults to current page.

strokeCap.description: End caps: NONE (default), ROUND, SQUARE, ARROW_LINES, ARROW_EQUILATERAL, DIAMOND_FILLED, TRIANGLE_FILLED, or CIRCLE_FILLED

tools.name: create_paint_style
tools.description: Create a new local paint style with a solid fill color. If a local style with this name exists, it is returned unchanged (existing: true).

tools.name: create_rectangle
tools.description: Create a new rectangle on the current page or inside a parent node.

layoutPositioning.description: AUTO (follow the parent's auto-layout flow) or ABSOLUTE (keep x/y and ignore the flow, e.g. a badge on a card)

layoutSizingHorizontal.description: Width sizing in an auto-layout parent: FIXED (keep the size), HUG (fit the content; auto-layout frames and text only) or FILL (stretch to fill the auto-layout parent)

layoutSizingVertical.description: Height sizing in an auto-layout parent: FIXED (keep the size), HUG (fit the content; auto-layout frames and text only) or FILL (stretch to fill the auto-layout parent)

parentId.description: Parent node ID in colon format. Defaults to current page.

tools.name: create_section
tools.description: Create a Figma Section node on the current page. Sections are the modern way to organize frames and groups on a page.

fillColor.description: Background color as hex e.g. #F7FAFC, or 'none' for no background (default: Figma's section color)

tools.name: create_svg
tools.description: Create vector layers from SVG markup (icons, logos, illustrations). Figma imports the SVG as a FRAME holding the vectors, sized from the SVG's width/height or viewBox. Give width or height to scale it keeping the aspect ratio (both with another ratio stretch it); strokes scale too. Returns the frame's id, bounds and childCount.

color.description: Hex color that replaces every currentColor in the markup (icon sets use it); without it currentColor imports as black

height.description: Height in pixels; alone it scales proportionally

layoutPositioning.description: AUTO (follow the parent's auto-layout flow) or ABSOLUTE (keep x/y and ignore the flow, e.g. a badge on a card)

layoutSizingHorizontal.description: Width sizing in an auto-layout parent: FIXED (keep the size), HUG (fit the content; auto-layout frames and text only) or FILL (stretch to fill the auto-layout parent)

layoutSizingVertical.description: Height sizing in an auto-layout parent: FIXED (keep the size), HUG (fit the content; auto-layout frames and text only) or FILL (stretch to fill the auto-layout parent)

parentId.description: Parent node ID in colon format. Defaults to current page.

svg.description: SVG markup, e.g. '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12l5 5L20 7" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/></svg>'

width.description: Width in pixels; alone it scales proportionally

x.description: X position relative to the parent (default 0)

y.description: Y position relative to the parent (default 0)

tools.name: create_text
tools.description: Create a new text node on the current page or inside a parent node. The font is loaded automatically before insertion. Without width the text grows on one line (use \n for line breaks); give width to wrap it at that width, which also makes textAlignHorizontal CENTER/RIGHT meaningful. Returns the created node ID and bounds. Use set_text to change the content and set_text_style to restyle it later.

fillColor.description: Text color as hex e.g. #000000 (default black)

fontFamily.description: Font family name e.g. 'Inter', 'Roboto', 'SF Pro Display' (default Inter). Must be a font installed in Figma (see get_fonts).

fontStyle.description: Font style exactly as Figma names it, e.g. 'Regular', 'Medium', 'Semi Bold', 'Bold', 'Italic' (Inter uses 'Semi Bold' with a space). If the style does not exist, the error lists the family's available styles.

layoutPositioning.description: AUTO (follow the parent's auto-layout flow) or ABSOLUTE (keep x/y and ignore the flow, e.g. a badge on a card)

layoutSizingHorizontal.description: Width sizing in an auto-layout parent: FIXED (keep the size), HUG (fit the content; auto-layout frames and text only) or FILL (stretch to fill the auto-layout parent)

layoutSizingVertical.description: Height sizing in an auto-layout parent: FIXED (keep the size), HUG (fit the content; auto-layout frames and text only) or FILL (stretch to fill the auto-layout parent)

lineHeight.description: Line height, in lineHeightUnit (default pixels). Omit for auto.

name.description: Node name shown in the layers panel (defaults to the text content)

parentId.description: Parent node ID in colon format. Defaults to current page.

textAlignVertical.description: TOP (default), CENTER, or BOTTOM (visible only when the box is taller than the text)

textAutoResize.description: WIDTH_AND_HEIGHT (grow on one line), HEIGHT (fixed width, wraps), NONE (fixed box), or TRUNCATE (fixed box, ends with …)

textCase.description: ORIGINAL (default), UPPER, LOWER, TITLE, SMALL_CAPS, or SMALL_CAPS_FORCED

width.description: Fixed width in pixels: the text wraps and its height follows the content (textAutoResize HEIGHT)

x.description: X position in pixels relative to the parent (default 0)

y.description: Y position in pixels relative to the parent (default 0)

tools.name: create_text_style
tools.description: Create a new local text style (typography preset). Returns the new style's ID. Apply it to nodes with apply_style_to_node. Use get_styles to list existing text styles. If a local style with this name exists, it is returned unchanged (existing: true).

description.description: Optional human-readable description shown in the Figma style panel

fontFamily.description: Font family name e.g. 'Inter', 'Roboto' (default Inter). Must be installed in Figma.

fontStyle.description: Font style exactly as Figma names it, e.g. 'Regular', 'Medium', 'Semi Bold', 'Bold', 'Italic' (Inter uses 'Semi Bold' with a space). If the style does not exist, the error lists the family's available styles. Default Regular.

letterSpacingUnit.description: Letter spacing unit: PIXELS (default) or PERCENT

letterSpacingValue.description: Letter spacing value (unit set by letterSpacingUnit)

lineHeightUnit.description: Line height unit: PIXELS (default) or PERCENT

lineHeightValue.description: Line height value (unit set by lineHeightUnit)

name.description: Style name — use slash notation to organise into groups e.g. 'Heading/H1', 'Body/Regular'

textDecoration.description: Text decoration: NONE (default), UNDERLINE, or STRIKETHROUGH

tools.name: create_variable
tools.description: Create a new variable (design token) inside an existing collection. Returns the new variable's ID. Use get_variable_defs to find collection IDs, set_variable_value to set values per mode, and bind_variable_to_node to apply the variable to a node property.

collectionId.description: ID of the variable collection to add this variable to (from get_variable_defs)

name.description: Variable name — use slash notation to group e.g. 'Color/Primary', 'Spacing/MD'

type.description: Variable type: COLOR (hex color), FLOAT (numeric dimension/spacing), STRING (text), or BOOLEAN (true/false toggle)

value.description: Initial value for the first mode. COLOR: hex e.g. #FF5733. FLOAT: number e.g. 16 (a FLOAT bound to opacity is a percent: 40 = 40%). STRING: text. BOOLEAN: true or false.

tools.name: create_variable_collection
tools.description: Create a new local variable collection with an optional initial mode name. NOTE — Figma free plan limits each collection to 1 mode. If you need Light/Dark (or any multi-mode) theming and the user is on the free plan, do NOT try to call add_variable_mode; instead use the name-prefix workaround: create all variables in a single collection and prefix each variable name with its mode, e.g. 'light/color-bg' and 'dark/color-bg'. Inform the user of this limitation.

tools.name: delete_nodes
tools.description: Delete one or more nodes. This cannot be undone via MCP — use with care. Layers inside an instance cannot be deleted (hide them with set_visible instead).

nodeIds.description: Node IDs to delete in colon format e.g. ['4029:12345']

tools.name: delete_page
tools.description: Delete a page from the Figma document. Cannot delete the only remaining page. Deleting the open page first opens the next page (currentPageId in the result).

pageId.description: Page node ID in colon format e.g. '0:2'

pageName.description: Exact page name to delete (alternative to pageId)

tools.name: delete_style
tools.description: Delete a style (paint, text, effect, or grid) by its ID.

tools.name: delete_variable
tools.description: Delete a single variable (provide variableId) or an entire collection and all its variables (provide collectionId). Provide exactly one of the two — not both.

collectionId.description: Collection ID to delete (removes all variables in the collection)

tools.name: detach_instance
tools.description: Detach one or more component instances, converting them to plain frames. The link to the main component is broken; all visual properties are preserved. An instance nested in another instance cannot be detached alone (Figma would detach the outer one too): detach the outer instance first.

nodeIds.description: INSTANCE node IDs in colon format e.g. ['4029:12345']

tools.name: edit_component_property
tools.description: Change a component property of a COMPONENT_SET or lone COMPONENT: rename it, change its default or INSTANCE_SWAP preferredValues, bind more layers or unbind some, or delete it (delete: true, alone; Figma also unbinds its layers). VARIANT properties can only be renamed. Returns {nodeId, property, key, type, default, boundLayers} (the key changes on rename; for TEXT, overwritten [{id, name, from}] lists layer texts the new default or the newly bound layers replaced), or {nodeId, property, deleted: true}.

defaultValue.description: New default: BOOLEAN true/false, TEXT text, INSTANCE_SWAP a COMPONENT node ID

delete.description: true deletes the property (pass nothing else)

layers.description: Layer IDs to bind to the property (other bindings of a layer are kept)

nodeId.description: COMPONENT_SET, or COMPONENT not in a set, in colon format

preferredValues.description: INSTANCE_SWAP only: replaces the swap choices (COMPONENT or COMPONENT_SET IDs)

property.description: Property name as read shows it (e.g. "Show icon") or its full key ("Show icon#12:0")

unbindLayers.description: Layer IDs to unbind from the property

tools.name: export_frames_to_pdf
tools.description: Export multiple frames as a single multi-page PDF file. Each frame becomes one page in order. Ideal for pitch decks, proposals, and slide exports.

nodeIds.description: Ordered list of frame node IDs to export as PDF pages, colon format e.g. '4029:12345'

outputPath.description: File path to write the PDF to, must end in .pdf (relative to working directory or absolute)

tools.name: export_tokens
tools.description: Export all design tokens (variables and paint styles) as JSON (colors as hex) or CSS custom properties (FLOAT in px unless scoped to opacity/font weight or named like opacity/weight/ratio…, STRING quoted, aliases as var(--name)). Ideal for bridging Figma variables into your codebase.

tools.name: find_replace_text
tools.description: Find and replace text content across all TEXT nodes in a subtree. Searches the entire current page if no nodeId is given.

find.description: Text string (or regex pattern when useRegex=true) to search for

nodeId.description: Root node ID to scope the search. Defaults to the entire current page.

regexFlags.description: Regex flags e.g. 'gi' (default 'g'). Only used when useRegex=true.

replace.description: Replacement string (use empty string to delete matches)

useRegex.description: Treat find as a regular expression (default false)

tools.name: get_annotations
tools.description: Get dev-mode annotations in the current document or scoped to a specific node. Returns annotation objects with label text, measurement type, and the ID of the annotated node. Omit nodeId to retrieve all annotations on the current page.

nodeId.description: Optional — scope results to annotations on this node and its descendants, colon format e.g. '4029:12345'

tools.name: get_design_context
tools.description: Get a depth-limited, token-efficient tree. Target priority: nodeId if given, else the current selection, else the current page — the response's target field says which one was used. Use this instead of get_document when exploring large files. Supports detail levels (minimal/compact/full) and dedupe_components for pages heavy with repeated component instances. Node format: bounds x/y are relative to the parent; default values are omitted (visible:false, opacity, locked:true, blendMode, constraints {horizontal, vertical} and clipsContent:false appear only when not default; constraints are left out on auto-layout children, where Figma ignores them, and on layers inside an instance, which repeat the main component's); auto-layout frames have a layout object {mode, gap, padding [top,right,bottom,left], align, counterAlign, sizing [h,v], strokesIncludedInLayout:true when strokes take room in the layout}, and children of auto-layout frames may have layout {sizing, positioning:'ABSOLUTE', minWidth/maxWidth/minHeight/maxHeight} (a hidden child's FILL reads as FIXED, i.e. no sizing: Figma does not report it while hidden); dedupe_components.description: When true, INSTANCE nodes are serialized compactly (mainComponentId + componentProperties + overrides: the layers that differ from the main component – text not bound to a property, visible/opacity/fills, a hidden layer without its contents, and nested instances as {id, name, type, mainComponentId? (when swapped or another variant), componentProperties? depth.description: How many levels deep to traverse (default 2; 0 = only the root node). Nodes at the cut-off level report childCount instead of children.

detail.description: Property verbosity: minimal (id/name/type/bounds, visible:false), compact (+layout, fills/strokes/cornerRadius/effects, opacity, rotation, text characters/fontSize/fontFamily), full (+all text styling, default)

nodeId.description: Root node to read, colon format e.g. '4029:12345' (a page ID works too). Overrides the user's selection. Omit to use the selection, or the current page if nothing is selected.

tools.name: get_fonts
tools.description: List all fonts used in the current page, sorted by usage frequency. A text node that uses several fonts counts once for each of them. Useful for understanding typography without scanning all text nodes.

tools.name: get_local_components
tools.description: Get all components and component sets in the current Figma file: id, name, key, componentSetId and variantProperties of each variant, and properties (name → {type, default, options?}) of each component set and non-variant component – the names create_instance and set_instance_properties take; INSTANCE_SWAP properties also list preferredValues [{id, name}] (the swap choices).

tools.name: get_metadata
tools.description: Get metadata about the current Figma document: file name, pages, current page

nodeIds.description: List of node IDs in colon format e.g. ['4029:12345', '4029:67890']

tools.name: get_pages
tools.description: List all pages in the document with their IDs and names. Lightweight alternative to get_document.

tools.name: get_reactions
tools.description: Get the prototype reactions defined on a node. Returns an array of reaction objects — each has a trigger (e.g. ON_CLICK, ON_HOVER, AFTER_TIMEOUT) and an actions array (navigate to node, open URL, go back, etc.), in the shape set_reactions takes (null fields dropped, numbers rounded). Use set_reactions to add or replace reactions, remove_reactions to delete them.

nodeId.description: Node ID in colon format e.g. '4029:12345'

tools.name: get_screenshot
tools.description: Export a screenshot of one or more nodes so you can look at them. A short text summary (nodeId, nodeName, format, width, height; for PNG/JPG width/height are the image's pixel size, i.e. about the node size × scale) comes first, then per node: PNG/JPG as an image, SVG as its markup text; PDF stays base64 in the summary. For big frames use scale 1 or lower. Set returnBase64 to get the image data as text instead (e.g. to pass to import_image or set_fills). Use save_screenshots to write files to disk.

format.description: Export format: PNG (default), SVG, JPG, or PDF

nodeIds.description: Optional node IDs to export, colon format. If empty, exports current selection.

returnBase64.description: Return {exports: [{nodeId, nodeName, format, base64, width, height}]} as JSON text instead of images – only when you need to copy the image data into another tool; you cannot see the image this way and the base64 costs many tokens. Default false.

tools.name: get_selection
tools.description: Get the nodes currently selected in Figma (full subtree of each) as {nodes: [...], globalVars?}. nodes is empty if nothing is selected. tools.name: get_styles
tools.description: Get all local styles in the document (paint, text, effect, and grid). Returns each style's id, name, description (when set) and value in the read format: paints ['#rrggbb' or paint objects], text {fontFamily, fontStyle, fontSize, lineHeight?, letterSpacing?, textDecoration?, textCase?}, effects in the set_effects format, layoutGrids {pattern, alignment?, count?, gutterSize?, offset?, sectionSize?, color?}. Use the style ID with apply_style_to_node or update_paint_style. For design tokens (variables), use get_variable_defs instead.

includeUsed.description: Also list under 'used' every style applied on the current page, including library (remote) styles that read tools show only by name (fillStyle, textStyle…): {id, name, type, remote, key?, value} with value in the read format (paints, font, effects). Pass the id to apply_style_to_node. When Figma cannot load a library style (its servers unreachable) the entry is {id, unresolved: true, type, value, nodeId} described from a node using it

tools.name: get_variable_defs
tools.description: Get all local variable definitions: collections, modes, and values per mode (COLOR as '#rrggbb' or '#rrggbbaa', aliases as {type: 'VARIABLE_ALIAS', id}). Variables are Figma's design token system.

tools.name: get_viewport
tools.description: Get the current Figma viewport: scroll center, zoom level, and visible bounds.

tools.name: group_nodes
tools.description: Group two or more nodes into a GROUP. All nodes must share the same parent.

name.description: Optional name for the new group

nodeIds.description: Node IDs to group (minimum 2), in colon format e.g. ['4029:12345', '4029:12346']

tools.name: import_image
tools.description: Import a base64-encoded image into Figma as a rectangle with an image fill. To copy an existing node as an image, take its base64 from get_screenshot with returnBase64: true; or provide your own base64 PNG/JPG.

layoutPositioning.description: AUTO (follow the parent's auto-layout flow) or ABSOLUTE (keep x/y and ignore the flow, e.g. a badge on a card)

layoutSizingHorizontal.description: Width sizing in an auto-layout parent: FIXED (keep the size), HUG (fit the content; auto-layout frames and text only) or FILL (stretch to fill the auto-layout parent)

layoutSizingVertical.description: Height sizing in an auto-layout parent: FIXED (keep the size), HUG (fit the content; auto-layout frames and text only) or FILL (stretch to fill the auto-layout parent)

parentId.description: Parent node ID in colon format. Defaults to current page.

scaleMode.description: Image scale mode: FILL (default), FIT, CROP, or TILE

tools.name: lock_nodes
tools.description: Lock one or more nodes to prevent accidental edits in Figma.

nodeIds.description: Node IDs in colon format e.g. ['4029:12345']

tools.name: move_nodes
tools.description: Set the x/y position of one or more nodes, relative to each node's parent (same coordinates as bounds in the read tools; for top-level nodes that is the canvas). The same x/y is applied to every node (not an offset). Children of an auto-layout frame are not moved (the layout positions them); their result carries a warning.

nodeIds.description: Node IDs in colon format e.g. ['4029:12345']

tools.name: navigate_to_page
tools.description: Switch the active Figma page. Provide either pageId or pageName.

pageId.description: Page node ID in colon format e.g. '0:1'

pageName.description: Exact page name to navigate to

tools.name: remove_reactions
tools.description: Remove prototype reactions from a node. Omit indices to remove all reactions. Provide a zero-based indices array to remove specific reactions (use get_reactions first to see current indices).

indices.description: Zero-based indices of reactions to remove. Omit or pass [] to remove all.

nodeId.description: Node ID in colon format e.g. '4029:12345'

tools.name: rename_node
tools.description: Rename a single node by ID. Returns the updated node with its new name. Use batch_rename_nodes to rename multiple nodes at once or to apply find/replace patterns across many nodes.

name.description: New name for the node. Figma supports slash-separated path notation e.g. 'Icons/Arrow/Left' to organise nodes in component panels.

nodeId.description: Node ID in colon format e.g. '4029:12345'

tools.name: rename_page
tools.description: Rename an existing page in the Figma document.

pageId.description: Page node ID in colon format e.g. '0:2'

pageName.description: Current page name to find (alternative to pageId)

tools.name: reorder_nodes
tools.description: Change the z-order (layer stack position) of one or more nodes.

nodeIds.description: Node IDs in colon format e.g. ['4029:12345']

order.description: Order operation: bringToFront, sendToBack, bringForward, or sendBackward

tools.name: reparent_nodes
tools.description: Move one or more nodes to a different parent frame, group, or section.

nodeIds.description: Node IDs to move in colon format e.g. ['4029:12345']

parentId.description: Target parent node ID in colon format e.g. '4029:99'

tools.name: resize_nodes
tools.description: Resize one or more nodes. The same width/height is applied to every node in the list independently. Provide width, height, or both; only children with SCALE constraints follow. Or give scale instead to scale proportionally like Figma's scale tool (K): children, stroke weights, font sizes, corner radii and effects scale too (use it for icons and groups).

nodeIds.description: Node IDs in colon format e.g. ['4029:12345']

scale.description: Scale factor (>= 0.01) instead of width/height, e.g. 3 turns a 24 px icon into 72 px

tools.name: rotate_nodes
tools.description: Rotate one or more nodes to an absolute angle in degrees. By default Figma's plugin API rotates around the node's top-left corner, so the node shifts; set aroundCenter=true to keep its centre in place like rotating in the Figma UI. Returns the new rotation and x/y.

aroundCenter.description: Rotate around the node's centre instead of its top-left corner (default false)

nodeIds.description: Node IDs in colon format e.g. ['4029:12345']

rotation.description: Rotation angle in degrees (positive = counter-clockwise in Figma)

tools.name: save_screenshots
tools.description: Export screenshots for multiple nodes and write them to the local filesystem. Returns file metadata (path, size, dimensions) — no base64 in the response. Use get_screenshot instead when you need the image data in memory.

format.description: Default export format: PNG (default), SVG, JPG, or PDF

items.description: List of {nodeId, outputPath, format?, scale?} objects

format.description: Export format: PNG, SVG, JPG, or PDF

nodeId.description: Node ID in colon format e.g. '4029:12345'

outputPath.description: File path to write the image to

scale.description: Default export scale for raster formats (default 2)

tools.name: scan_nodes_by_types
tools.description: Find all nodes of specific types in a subtree, regardless of name. Use search_nodes instead when you need to filter by name.

nodeId.description: Root node ID to scan from, colon format e.g. '4029:12345'

tools.name: scan_text_nodes
tools.description: Scan all TEXT nodes in a subtree and return their content. Shorthand for scan_nodes_by_types with ['TEXT'] — use when you only need text copy from a component or frame.

nodeId.description: Root node ID to scan from, colon format e.g. '4029:12345'

tools.name: search_nodes
tools.description: Search for nodes by name substring and/or type within a subtree. Use this when you know (part of) the node name. Use scan_nodes_by_types when you want all nodes of a type regardless of name.

nodeId.description: Scope search to this subtree (default: current page), colon format e.g. '4029:12345'

types.description: Filter by Figma node type e.g. ['TEXT', 'FRAME', 'COMPONENT']

tools.name: set_auto_layout
tools.description: Set or update auto-layout (flex) properties and content clipping on a FRAME, COMPONENT, COMPONENT_SET or INSTANCE. Turning auto-layout on makes the main axis hug its content (Figma default); pass primaryAxisSizingMode FIXED to keep the current size. Turning it on also draws strokes over the padding instead of in the layout (strokesIncludedInLayout false, as in Figma's UI; set_strokes changes it). To size or position the children (FILL/HUG, ABSOLUTE), use set_layout_child.

clipsContent.description: true clips children to the frame bounds (Figma default for new frames), false lets them overflow

counterAxisAlignItems.description: Cross-axis alignment: MIN, CENTER, MAX, or BASELINE

counterAxisSpacing.description: Gap between wrapped rows/columns (only when layoutWrap is WRAP)

layoutMode.description: Auto-layout direction: HORIZONTAL, VERTICAL, or NONE

nodeId.description: FRAME, COMPONENT, COMPONENT_SET or INSTANCE node ID in colon format e.g. '4029:12345'

primaryAxisAlignItems.description: Main-axis alignment: MIN, CENTER, MAX, or SPACE_BETWEEN

tools.name: set_blend_mode
tools.description: Set the blend mode of one or more nodes (e.g. MULTIPLY, SCREEN, OVERLAY).

blendMode.description: Blend mode: NORMAL, MULTIPLY, SCREEN, OVERLAY, DARKEN, LIGHTEN, COLOR_DODGE, COLOR_BURN, HARD_LIGHT, SOFT_LIGHT, DIFFERENCE, EXCLUSION, HUE, SATURATION, COLOR, LUMINOSITY, PASS_THROUGH

nodeIds.description: Node IDs in colon format e.g. ['4029:12345']

tools.name: set_constraints
tools.description: Set layout constraints (pinning behaviour) on one or more nodes relative to their parent.

horizontal.description: Horizontal constraint: MIN (left), MAX (right), CENTER, STRETCH, or SCALE

nodeIds.description: Node IDs in colon format e.g. ['4029:12345']

vertical.description: Vertical constraint: MIN (top), MAX (bottom), CENTER, STRETCH, or SCALE

tools.name: set_corner_radius
tools.description: Set corner radius on one or more nodes. Provide a uniform cornerRadius or individual per-corner values. Each result reports cornerRadius as a number, or [topLeft, topRight, bottomRight, bottomLeft] when the corners differ.

cornerRadius.description: Uniform corner radius applied to all corners

nodeIds.description: Node IDs in colon format e.g. ['4029:12345']

tools.name: set_effects
tools.description: Apply one or more effects (drop shadow, inner shadow, layer blur, background blur) directly to a node (nodeId), or the same effects to several nodes (nodeIds). Replaces all existing effects. Pass an empty array to clear all effects.

effects.description: Array of effect objects, in the same format read tools report styles.effects. Each has: type (DROP_SHADOW | INNER_SHADOW | LAYER_BLUR | BACKGROUND_BLUR), radius (default 4); shadows also take color (hex; a #RRGGBBAA alpha is the shadow opacity), opacity (0–1, overrides the color alpha; default 0.25 when the color has no alpha), offset [x, y] or offsetX/offsetY (default 0, 4), spread, blendMode; visible (default true)

nodeId.description: Node ID in colon format e.g. '4029:12345'. Give nodeId or nodeIds

nodeIds.description: Several node IDs that get the same value; the result is then {results: [one entry per node, or {nodeId, error}]}

tools.name: set_fills
tools.description: Set the fills of a node (nodeId), or the same fills on several nodes (nodeIds): one solid color, or a list of paints in the format read returns (solid, gradient, image). Use mode='append' to stack them on top of the existing fills; paints [] removes all fills. Returns the node's fills as read shows them.

color.description: Solid fill color as hex: #RRGGBB e.g. #FF5733 or #RRGGBBAA e.g. #FF573380 for 50% alpha. Give color or paints.

mode.description: 'replace' (default) overwrites all existing fills; 'append' stacks the new fills on top of existing ones

nodeId.description: Node ID in colon format e.g. '4029:12345'. Give nodeId or nodeIds

nodeIds.description: Several node IDs that get the same value; the result is then {results: [one entry per node, or {nodeId, error}]}

opacity.description: Opacity 0–1 of the color fill (default 1). Combines multiplicatively with any alpha in the color hex.

paints.description: Paint objects in Figma order (first = bottom), as read returns them: {type:'SOLID', color:'#hex', variable?} (variable = color variable name, 'Collection/name' when the name exists in several collections, or ID; binds the token); {type:'GRADIENT_LINEAR', stops:['#hex', ...], positions?:[0..1], angle?} (CSS degrees, 90 = left to right, default 180 = top to bottom); {type:'GRADIENT_RADIAL'|'GRADIENT_ANGULAR'|'GRADIENT_DIAMOND', stops, positions?, center?:[x, y] fractions of the node}; {type:'IMAGE', imageData (base64), scaleMode?: FILL|FIT|CROP|TILE}. Each may have opacity 0–1. A plain '#hex' string (as read shows solid paints) is accepted too.

tools.name: set_instance_properties
tools.description: Set component properties of INSTANCE nodes: switch variant, toggle BOOLEAN layers, change TEXT properties, swap nested instances (INSTANCE_SWAP takes a COMPONENT node ID). Only the given properties change. Unknown names or values fail per node with the list of accepted ones. Returns per-node results with the new mainComponentId, componentProperties and bounds.

nodeIds.description: INSTANCE node IDs in colon format e.g. ['4029:12345']

properties.description: Component property values by name, e.g. {"Size": "Large", "Label": "Pay now", "Show icon": false}. Names are as get_local_components lists them (the '#…' suffix is optional); VARIANT takes one of its options, BOOLEAN true/false, TEXT a string, INSTANCE_SWAP a COMPONENT node ID

tools.name: set_layout_child
tools.description: Set how nodes sit in their auto-layout parent: FILL/HUG/FIXED sizing per axis (FILL on the parent's main axis grows like flex-grow, on the cross axis it stretches), ABSOLUTE positioning, and min/max width/height (auto-layout frames and their children only; 0 removes a limit). Returns per-node sizing and bounds.

layoutPositioning.description: AUTO (follow the parent's auto-layout flow) or ABSOLUTE (keep x/y and ignore the flow, e.g. a badge on a card)

layoutSizingHorizontal.description: Width sizing in an auto-layout parent: FIXED (keep the size), HUG (fit the content; auto-layout frames and text only) or FILL (stretch to fill the auto-layout parent)

layoutSizingVertical.description: Height sizing in an auto-layout parent: FIXED (keep the size), HUG (fit the content; auto-layout frames and text only) or FILL (stretch to fill the auto-layout parent)

maxHeight.description: Maximum height in pixels (0 removes it)

maxWidth.description: Maximum width in pixels (0 removes it)

minHeight.description: Minimum height in pixels (0 removes it)

minWidth.description: Minimum width in pixels (0 removes it)

nodeIds.description: Node IDs in colon format e.g. ['4029:12345']

tools.name: set_opacity
tools.description: Set the opacity of one or more nodes (0 = fully transparent, 1 = fully opaque).

nodeIds.description: Node IDs in colon format e.g. ['4029:12345']

tools.name: set_reactions

mode.description: "replace" (default) overwrites all existing reactions; "append" adds to them

nodeId.description: Node ID in colon format e.g. '4029:12345'

reactions.description: Array of reaction objects. Each has a 'trigger' and an 'actions' array (plural) of Action objects.

tools.name: set_strokes
tools.description: Set the strokes (borders) of a node (nodeId), or the same strokes on several nodes (nodeIds): paint (one color, or paints like set_fills) and/or geometry – weight, per-side weights, align, dash, cap, join. Only the given properties change, so e.g. strokeAlign alone keeps the current color. Returns the node's strokes and stroke geometry as read shows them.

color.description: Solid stroke color as hex e.g. #000000

dashPattern.description: Dash and gap lengths in pixels e.g. [4, 2]; [] = solid line

mode.description: 'replace' (default) overwrites all strokes; 'append' stacks on top of existing strokes

nodeId.description: Node ID in colon format e.g. '4029:12345'. Give nodeId or nodeIds

nodeIds.description: Several node IDs that get the same value; the result is then {results: [one entry per node, or {nodeId, error}]}

paints.description: Paint objects in Figma order (first = bottom), as read returns them: {type:'SOLID', color:'#hex', variable?} (variable = color variable name, 'Collection/name' when the name exists in several collections, or ID; binds the token); {type:'GRADIENT_LINEAR', stops:['#hex', ...], positions?:[0..1], angle?} (CSS degrees, 90 = left to right, default 180 = top to bottom); {type:'GRADIENT_RADIAL'|'GRADIENT_ANGULAR'|'GRADIENT_DIAMOND', stops, positions?, center?:[x, y] fractions of the node}; {type:'IMAGE', imageData (base64), scaleMode?: FILL|FIT|CROP|TILE}. Each may have opacity 0–1. A plain '#hex' string (as read shows solid paints) is accepted too.

strokeCap.description: Line ends of open paths and lines: NONE, ROUND, SQUARE, ARROW_LINES, ARROW_EQUILATERAL, DIAMOND_FILLED, TRIANGLE_FILLED, or CIRCLE_FILLED

strokeWeight.description: Stroke weight in pixels, all sides

strokeWeights.description: Per-side weights [top, right, bottom, left] e.g. [0, 0, 1, 0] for a bottom border (frames, components, instances, rectangles)

strokesIncludedInLayout.description: Auto-layout frames: true makes the stroke take space in the layout (content moves in by the stroke weight), false draws it over the padding. Default: unchanged, and false when an auto-layout frame without a visible stroke gets its first one (as in Figma's UI)

tools.name: set_text
tools.description: Update the text content of an existing TEXT node. All fonts used in the node are loaded first; like typing in Figma, the new text takes the style of the first character. Use set_text_style to change fonts, sizes or alignment. On a component's layer bound to a TEXT property, the text becomes the property's default, shown by every bound layer (the result has a note); in an instance it changes only that instance.

nodeId.description: TEXT node ID in colon format e.g. '4029:12345'

tools.name: set_text_style
tools.description: Change the typography of existing TEXT nodes. Only the given properties change: fontFamily alone keeps each range's style, fontStyle alone keeps the family. Font, size, line height, letter spacing, decoration, case and color apply to the whole text, or to the characters [start, end) when start/end are given (e.g. bold one word); alignment, textAutoResize and width always apply to the whole node. Returns per-node results with the new bounds.

end.description: End character index (exclusive) for a range; default the text length

fontStyle.description: Font style exactly as Figma names it, e.g. 'Regular', 'Medium', 'Semi Bold', 'Bold', 'Italic' (Inter uses 'Semi Bold' with a space). If the style does not exist, the error lists the family's available styles.

lineHeightUnit.description: PIXELS (default), PERCENT, or AUTO (lineHeight not needed)

nodeIds.description: TEXT node IDs in colon format e.g. ['4029:12345']

start.description: Start character index (inclusive, 0-based) for a range; default 0

textAutoResize.description: WIDTH_AND_HEIGHT (grow on one line), HEIGHT (fixed width, wraps), NONE (fixed box), or TRUNCATE (fixed box, ends with …)

textCase.description: ORIGINAL, UPPER, LOWER, TITLE, SMALL_CAPS, or SMALL_CAPS_FORCED

width.description: Fixed width in pixels; switches to textAutoResize HEIGHT (wrap) unless textAutoResize is given

tools.name: set_variable_value
tools.description: Set a variable's value for a specific mode.

value.description: Value to set. COLOR: hex e.g. #FF5733. FLOAT: number e.g. 16 (a FLOAT bound to opacity is a percent: 40 = 40%). STRING: text. BOOLEAN: true or false.

tools.name: set_visible
tools.description: Show or hide one or more nodes by setting their visibility.

nodeIds.description: Node IDs in colon format e.g. ['4029:12345']

visible.description: true to show the node, false to hide it

tools.name: swap_component
tools.description: Swap the main component of an existing INSTANCE node, replacing it with a different component while keeping position and size. Like an instance swap in Figma's editor, a layer name you changed is kept (a name still equal to the old component's name follows the new component), and so are the overrides that still match the new component's layers (e.g. a stroke color on the same icon vector). A deleted component is refused.

componentId.description: Target COMPONENT node ID in colon format (from get_local_components)

nodeId.description: INSTANCE node ID in colon format e.g. 4029:12345

tools.name: ungroup_nodes
tools.description: Ungroup one or more GROUP nodes, moving their children to the parent (same stacking order) and removing the group.

nodeIds.description: GROUP node IDs in colon format e.g. ['4029:12345']

tools.description: Unlock one or more nodes, allowing them to be edited again.

nodeIds.description: Node IDs in colon format e.g. ['4029:12345']

tools.description: Update an existing paint style's name, color, or description. Only paint styles support in-place updates — to modify text, effect, or grid styles, use delete_style and recreate them.

color.description: New fill color as hex e.g. #FF5733
